title: Full-Body Foundation
summary: A balanced introduction to squats, push movements, hinges, and supported core work.
steps: Complete 3 rounds: 10 chair squats, 8 incline push-ups, 10 hip hinges, 8 reverse lunges per side, and a 20-second plank. Rest 60 seconds between rounds.
benefit: Builds whole-body control and confidence with fundamental movement patterns.

title: Upper-Body Builder
summary: A push-and-pull session for the chest, back, shoulders, and arms.
steps: Complete 4 sets of 10 dumbbell floor presses, 10 one-arm rows per side, 8 overhead presses, and 12 hammer curls. Rest 75 seconds after each round.
benefit: Develops upper-body strength while balancing pressing and pulling muscles.

title: Lower-Body Power
summary: A demanding lower-body workout that combines strength, balance, and controlled power.
steps: Complete 4 rounds: 12 goblet squats, 10 Romanian deadlifts, 10 split squats per side, and 12 weighted glute bridges. Finish with 3 sets of 8 squat jumps.
benefit: Improves lower-body strength, hip stability, and force production.

title: Steady Cardio Walk
summary: A brisk, joint-friendly walk with simple pace changes to build aerobic consistency.
steps: Warm up for 5 minutes, walk briskly for 5 minutes, then alternate 2 minutes fast and 2 minutes comfortable for 16 minutes. Cool down for 5 minutes.
benefit: Supports heart health and endurance with a manageable impact level.

title: Interval Energizer
summary: Short work intervals and active recovery raise the heart rate without a long session.
steps: After a 4-minute warm-up, complete 8 rounds of 40 seconds high knees or fast marching and 50 seconds easy movement. Finish with a 6-minute cooldown.
benefit: Builds cardiovascular capacity and makes efficient use of limited time.

title: Cardio Power Circuit
summary: A fast circuit that alternates rope work with athletic bodyweight movements.
steps: Complete 5 rounds: 60 seconds jump rope, 12 squat thrusts, 10 skater hops per side, 30 seconds mountain climbers, and 45 seconds rest.
benefit: Challenges coordination, speed, and sustained high-intensity effort.

title: Morning Mobility Reset
summary: Gentle controlled movements prepare the hips, spine, and shoulders for the day.
steps: Move slowly through cat-cow, thread-the-needle, half-kneeling hip flexor stretches, ankle rocks, and shoulder circles for 45 seconds each. Repeat twice.
benefit: Reduces morning stiffness and encourages comfortable range of motion.

title: Hip Mobility Flow
summary: A focused sequence for hip rotation, flexion, and extension with controlled transitions.
steps: Complete 3 rounds of 90/90 switches, adductor rocks, deep squat holds, lunge-to-hamstring transitions, and glute bridges. Spend 45 seconds on each movement.
benefit: Improves hip movement quality for squats, walking, and daily comfort.

title: Athletic Mobility Flow
summary: A continuous movement flow that combines balance, deep positions, and active control.
steps: Flow through inchworms, world’s greatest stretch, Cossack squats, bear-to-crab transitions, and controlled kick-throughs. Complete 4 smooth rounds with minimal rest.
benefit: Connects mobility with strength and coordination across multiple planes.

title: Core Stability Basics
summary: Low-impact core training built around breathing, bracing, and slow control.
steps: Complete 3 rounds: 8 dead bugs per side, 10 glute bridges, 8 bird dogs per side, and a 20-second side plank from the knees on each side.
benefit: Builds trunk stability that supports posture and everyday movement.

title: Core Control Circuit
summary: A focused circuit that trains the core to resist extension, rotation, and side bending.
steps: Complete 4 rounds: 10 band presses per side, 10 slow plank shoulder taps per side, 12 reverse crunches, and a 25-second suitcase hold per side.
benefit: Improves core control for lifting, carrying, and changing direction.

title: Advanced Core Challenge
summary: Longer lever positions and dynamic planks challenge total trunk endurance.
steps: Complete 4 rounds: 10 hollow-body rocks, 8 plank walkouts, 12 cross-body mountain climbers per side, 10 V-ups, and a 30-second side plank per side.
benefit: Develops high-level core endurance and full-body tension.

title: Gentle Recovery Session
summary: Breathing and easy stretches help the body unwind after training or a long day.
steps: Begin with 2 minutes of slow breathing, then hold child’s pose, lying spinal twist, hamstring stretch, figure-four stretch, and chest opener for 60 seconds per side.
benefit: Encourages relaxation and gentle movement without adding training stress.

title: Active Recovery Walk
summary: An easy conversational-pace walk keeps the body moving between harder sessions.
steps: Walk at an easy pace for 20 minutes while keeping your breathing relaxed. Finish with 5 minutes of gentle calf, hip flexor, and chest stretches.
benefit: Promotes circulation and maintains the habit of movement on lighter days.

title: Recovery Mobility Plus
summary: A longer restoration session combines soft-tissue work, mobility, and calm breathing.
steps: Use the foam roller for calves, quadriceps, upper back, and glutes for 60 seconds each. Follow with hip switches, thoracic rotations, ankle rocks, and 5 minutes of relaxed breathing.
benefit: Creates a structured recovery practice after demanding training periods.
